description: Port calls of a ship between two times (UTC, ISO 8601), from the AIS Trail archive: port, arrival, departure, draught on arrival and departure, cargo estimate (loaded, ballast or unchanged, from the draught change), previous and next port. Give mmsi or imo. A port call starts when the ship stops for at least 15 minutes inside a port area and ends when it leaves; departure is null while it is still in port. Needs an AIS Trail API key sent by the MCP client as the HTTP header 'Authorization: Bearer ap_live_…'. At most 100 port calls per call and at most 366 days; the plan's history depth, credits (1 per port call returned), rate limit and 24-hour delay (on plans without live data) apply.
name: vessel_port_calls
title: Ship port calls (API key)
